tickets.title: Obtain Velvet Acorn Life Insurance reinstatement terms
tickets.text: Obtain reinstatement terms, catch-up premium, conversion availability, and underwriting requirements from Velvet Acorn Life Insurance for Arlo Copperwisp's lapsed term policy.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain that carrier information by March 1, 2024.

tickets.title: Process recurring payment change request
tickets.text: Update the authorized recurring payment source for Arlo Copperwisp's insurance policies from the closed Pocket Lantern Bank account to the Teacup Comet Bank operating account.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to update the payment source by February 29, 2024.

tickets.title: Collect current property and casualty declarations
tickets.text: Collect current declarations pages for the home, auto, umbrella, and rental property for the Copperwisp household to confirm coverage limits.
tickets.evidence: Current declarations are needed by March 8, 2024.

tickets.title: Review rental condo protection coverage
tickets.text: Review the protection coverage for the Bend rental condo, including landlord, tenant, liability, property loss, and loss-of-rent exposures.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review that protection by March 15, 2024.

tickets.title: Compare employer benefits with private coverage
tickets.text: Compare the supplemental life, disability, and beneficiary settings in the Moonbadger Robotics benefits election with the Copperwisp household's private coverage.
tickets.evidence: That comparison is needed by March 5, 2024.

tickets.title: Obtain Velvet Acorn Life Insurance beneficiary evidence
tickets.text: Obtain current carrier evidence from Velvet Acorn Life Insurance to resolve the discrepancy between the carrier portal and the Cloudberry Kite Custody planning file regarding beneficiary arrangements.
tickets.evidence: That evidence is needed by March 12, 2024.

tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text: Collect the Copperwisp household's estate planning documents, specifically seeking trust funding evidence and verifying fiduciary roles against the current household and insurance beneficiary structure.

subTasks.title: Request and log estate documents
subTasks.text: Send the standard document request checklist to the Copperwisp household and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
subTasks.text: Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor gap summary
subTasks.text: Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for the lead advisor before any client-facing recommendations are discussed.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to collect the estate planning documents by March 22, 2024.
